evals.prompt: Create a new block called 'product-card' that displays a product title, description, and a 'Learn More' button. Use the BBL design system tokens for all styling, ensuring the title uses H4-medium and the button is L size. Provide the CSS and JS for this block, mobile-first.
evals.expected_output: CSS and JS files using BBL tokens (e.g., --font-heading-small, --rounded-md, --color-primary-active).

evals.prompt: Apply BBL typography to a hero section. The main title should be D1-medium and the sub-header H3-medium. Ensure the line-heights are correct for both English and Thai scripts as per the BBL design system.
evals.expected_output: CSS that correctly applies rem and em values for D1 and H3 for both mobile and desktop views.
